title: Construct Binary Search Tree from Preorder Traversal
summary: Given an array representing the preorder traversal of a binary search tree, construct the tree and return its root.
statement: Given an array representing the preorder traversal of a binary search tree, construct the tree and return its root. Ensure every node's left descendant has a value less than the node, and every right descendant has a value greater. The array guarantees a valid BST can be constructed.
constraints: Values are distinct and preorder represents a valid BST.

Carry an exclusive upper bound and one shared input index.
If the next value exceeds the bound return null; otherwise consume it and build left with node value, right with inherited bound.
BST ordering and preorder make each next value belong to the earliest recursive frame whose bound admits it.
